notes.title: [Regular Update]Version 0.9.4.2
notes.content:
[h1]Game Version 0.9.4.2[/h1]

[h2]Overview[/h2]
-Add a new set of regular enemies: wolf, digger, bat and snake
-Add a new set of elite enemies: Living Wood and Spirit Deer
-Add a new Boss: Chimera
-Add 5 new random events
-Optimize the display of battle information: adjust the display and disappearance speed of battle information

[h2]The Secret Forest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/fe1b6527193bf9def4ad28f789022b20dff15fec.png[/img]
Attempt to find a way out under the siege of wild beasts and living plants in the new timeline of the secret forest, and win victory through the trials of the mother beast Chimera
You will face .......
-Wild Animals that skilled at adding various negative effects
-A giant tree
-Spirit deer that can quickly restore her life
-The mother beast Chimera


[h2]Interaction and UI[/h2]
-Modified the logic for viewing upgraded cards and connected cards: now you can only view these card when viewing cards' details 
-Fixed a bug where the slot information of certain cards does not display on the details page in certain situations
-Fixed a bug where the information displays remains after it has been played
-Viewing preview cards in the store and deck also uses the same card information display logic: right-click and then view detailed information
-Fixed the issue where clicking on a controllable character during card pre casting resulted in the inability to cancel pre casting after character switching
-Fixed a bug where kill animations still take effect when exiting the combat process


[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
-The difficulty option for Advanced 20 has been redone as follows: difficulty increases with each new timeline entered
-Team Bonus [Tactics] Temporary Upgrade Card Effect Duration: Until card resolves ->Until the end of the combat
-Team Bonus [Energy] Reworked into: Every 10 accumulated energy points provide 1 damage boost to all attack cards of the character, and energy will not be consumed in a single combat
-Add new team bonus [Healing]: Provides continuous recovery effects for team characters
-Add a new card ability [Attribute Challenge]: If the target's attribute value is less than or equal to the required value, the subsequent abilities will resolve
-Add a new card ability [Stimulate]: Immediately activate the target's specific buff effect once
-Add a new BUFF effect [Balanced]: special effect. When obtaining this effect, all attribute values of the character will be evenly distributed as much as possible, and the effect will continue until the end of the combat
-The following card effects and their upgraded versions have been adjusted or reworked: Battle Heat,  Flaming Cleave, Lava Strike, Bounce Shot, Quick Reload, Shrapnel, Centralize Fire, Refresh Dash, Revolve, Guiding Signal, Words in Wind, Eul's Binding, Quick Mastery
-Some enemies have been nerfed

notes.title: [Update Log] Game Version 0.9.4.0
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.9.4.0[/h1]
[strike]Don't ask about version 0.9.3.x[/strike]

[h2]Overview[/h2]
-All characters have received art resource updates and have new combat displays
-New advanced difficulty system
-More detailed and clear card guidance
-Optimize damage preview
-Optimize resource system
-New System: Bonfire Upgrade
-New System: Team Bonus

[h2]Fresh it up?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/188af3b6df09048981829bdba220ced8e6204813.jpg[/img]
Updated the art resources for [b]all characters[/b], which are more in line with the current combat logic and interface layout
Through a poor imitation of a certain game, the card resolve during combat will display a short animation effect, showing the card caster and the card target, to avoid the chaotic situation that flashes by during each turn[strike]（But it still seems quite chaotic）[/strike]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/c6d91149e8b641b174083cf4a99d34348707beb9.png[/img]
At the same time, there will be icon updates for the [b] status effects [/b], which will be distinguished by color and allow you to see the categories of these effects more intuitively

[h2]We need A20[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/55f0c4f929fc4a7d4aab0d25c9c2dc3e724f0fb0.png[/img]
The new advanced difficulty system has been updated!
Enemy values increase, cards upgrade, and face various negative effects and resource shortages, then challenge your luck and wisdom!

[h2]Card Details plz[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/4f78f46847807de4ebfbfa9087154a3b103c7290.png[/img]
Just a small feature: now when displaying card details, you can see card speed, category, range and other information more clearly. I hope it is helpful to you

[h2]Optimized damage preview[/h2]
The new damage preview will also help you preview the card damage you point to the target! No need to carefully calculate the damage of the cards in hand, simply hover the mouse over the target to predict the future
The damage preview still has a long way to go, and I am still trying to see if it can fully cover every armor and special effect that is about to be applied

[h2]Resources[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/26b6e91169755249e1520c6e459ee0926c6e14b4.png[/img]
The new resource system has been updated
Now, cash and supplies will become temporary resources within each run, and their main purpose has not changed
The new permanent resource Token will replace the original cash resources and become a special permanent resource primarily serving the black market
Token resources can be obtained by completing games or trading on the black market

[h2]Bonfire Lit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/175aa7689dc8e5135bfc56cb21fa432203bbf3e7.png[/img]
Although the campfire is good, we have more expectations for it. This update adds 35[b] campfire upgrades[/b]
Now, using supplies can upgrade the bonfire, and each upgrade selects one of the three upgrade options with consistent rarity
These upgrade effects will change the effectiveness of the campfire, allowing you to gain beneficial additional effects when lighting or killing time at the campfire



[h2]Team Bonus[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/2473294701da59d66e4ed49388d6be6cdd367525.png[/img]
This update introduces 16 unique team bonus effects
Each character will now be able to provide 4 out of these 16 team bonus effects
By reaching the threshold value of the attribute, the corresponding team's bonus effect can be increased by 1 level
To achieve a higher level of team bonus effect, you may need multiple characters that can provide the same bonus to join your team, or use more expensive tools to increase the team bonus level
Reasonably build your team and try to achieve higher levels of team bonuses

[h2]And other staff ......[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay and Balance[/h3]
-Each map event now uses [b] independent available time [/b] and cannot accumulate previously unused time
-Added 20 tools for increasing team bonus levels
-Added upgraded versions of [b] all enemy cards [/b]
-Remake the effects of some cards and their upgraded cards
-Armor effect has been updated: The armor value now has a default upper limit, which is the maximum HP of the character
-The Marked ability effect has been updated: it will no longer consume all the marking effects, but only reduce one layer
-Added a new special effect [Soul]: The character's current HP will not exceed 1
-Added a new prompt effect associated with the [Detection] team bonus, [Exposure]: This character has 0 cards and will take additional damage
-Updated the option for Rift to move to the next timeline, now you will choose the next timeline while selecting rewards

[h3]UI and Interaction[/h3]
-The settings panel of the new game will display detailed information about artifacts and advanced levels
-Added the function of viewing historical game records in the main menu
-Independently added the display of [b] black market [/b] on the main interface
-Now, cards with durability can switch their effectiveness during battles


[h2]Last but not least[/h2]
Timeout has another content update in the plan, mainly focusing on new enemies and random events. It will be launched gradually in the next 1-2 months and will end early access after that
Thank you for your support

notes.title: [Change Log] Game Version 0.9.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Change Log Version 0.9.2.0[/h1]
[h2]UI & Interact[/h2]

[b]Card figure display update[/b]

The value of the card will now display its default value after attribute bonus in its default state, and the color of the value represents the attribute bonus it received：[color=red]STR[/color]，[color=green]DEX[/color]，[color=blue]INT[/color]，[color=purple]PER[/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/008f25f4de38235d5ebcb2d4df8c393890beeea3.jpg[/img]
After right clicking to view details, the card will display its basic value and specific bonus value
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/da96fc4bbeea3c0d63b103ea94b1f18340809975.jpg[/img]

-[b]Card upgrade details preview[/b]
When viewing a card, holding down the [X] key on the keyboard can preview the upgraded version of the card. The value previewed in the upgraded version will not calculate the current bonus value


-Shop UI layout changed
-Combat UI layout changed

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
Few cards changed effects and reworked
Relic Inscription: The abnormal state of the character will no longer be retained at the end of the combat

[h3]Card Upgrade[/h3]
Added upgraded versions to all non-enemy cards in the game, which will change one or more of their damage, attributes, speed, range, abilities, etc
During the game, you can upgrade the cards in your card box on the [b]black market[/b] by spend a certain amount of time according to the rarity of the cards

[h3]Combat Reward[/h3]
The efficiency of combat rewards during the game is too high, and there is a mismatch between the growth rate of player characters and the increase in game difficulty
To slow down the growth rate of characters and open up space for more strategic choices, the card rewards for battles have now been changed from rewarding all 3 cards to selecting 1 card

[h3]Shop & Blackmarket[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/9276c25a33d5d1bc57a991f790f06f16e685d641.jpg[/img]
The layout of the shop has been changed, and we have hired a new salesperson to provide simple guidance for your shopping
However, the shop is no longer able to [b] trade[/b], and you may need to find some other channels to dump your waste cards ......

So, welcome to the [b]black market[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/ed483f98460aa819f91633cd2f2963de82c7791e.jpg[/img]
The black market only opens its entrance after you have broken the law of time and exceeded the next [b]limit time point[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/c35944254a8586340917b5e7a054649fa8a55299.jpg[/img]
Although the black market cannot obtain a large amount of resources from official stores, it provides [b] trades [/b] and three special services
[b] Card Upgrade [/b]: Spend a certain amount of time upgrading your cards! Of course, consuming time means you need to face [b]timeout penalties[/b]
[b] Safe case [/b]: Consume (3) cash to store cards, the safe case can store up to 3 cards, and you will be able to consume (3) more time to retrieve these cards for use in any future game
[b] Gacha Machine [/b]: Come and try your luck. Every time you spend (1) cash and (1) time, you have a chance to get a legendary quality card or advanced tool from the prize pool. After emptying the prize pool, a new one will be filled!

[h3]External growth content and difficulty options[/h3]
In addition to unlocking new cards and characters during the game, this version has added lightweight new external growth content
[b]The Relic Blessing[/b] system will allow you to unlock a permanent bonus for each character wins with a specific relic active. The bonus effect of each character is not completely the same
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/49870eec0f8b467657ffbe95f5632e78888242a8.jpg[/img]
[b]Advanced Difficulty[/b]
When starting a new game, you will be able to adjust the difficulty progression options and unlock new progression levels upon completion
In the current version, the advanced level will only affect the enemy's HP and card configuration, and new content will be gradually added in the future
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/617efc5dedd456cf2c94b27d936e556708606fa2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sundry[/h2]
-Partial optimization of art resources
-Card ability triggers will no longer display their ability description box

Thank you for your attention and support!

notes.title: [Change Log] Game Version 0.9.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Change Log Version 0.9.1.0[/h1]

[h2]Combat UI Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/6ccae1361c569459be0fa2119ef45c214870cc7f.jpg[/img]
In order to address the negative experience caused by overly complex combat interface information, the UI of the battle interface has been redesigned and updated.
The new combat interface UI only focuses on the information of up to one ally and one enemy, rather than displaying information of all characters, allowing players to complete operations on a simpler user interface

[h2]Position System Update[/h2]

The distance calculation between the two characters is not face-to-face, but horizontal, which will mainly affect the cards with [b]melee[/b] range

 [b]Melee[/b] range reworked: can only target enemy at the forefront

The same applies to enemies. Now melee cards will target the character at the forefront of your team

You can adjust the team order in the main interface. The smaller the position number in the upper left corner of the role, the higher the position of the role
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050985/3ea976510f195cd52883eab0e374f70a58934657.jpg[/img]

[h2]Card Balance Updates[/h2]
New abilities：
-Move backward: Move target character backward for 1 position if able
-Move forward: Move target character forward for 1 position if able

Following cards has changes：
- Force Push: [Mastery: Gain Armor(6)]->[Mastery:Move target backward]
-Improvise: Range changed form self -> ally
-Battle Rage: remove discard (3)
-Brave: Range changed form self ->ally, [Threshold(3): gain enhance(2)]->[Threshold(3): gain enhance(2)]
-Standstill: add [this character move forward], remove [Dispel]
-Daybreak: Reworked into [Charge(4)：apply Immune(1)] 
-Challenger:Add [this character move forward]
-Pulling Strike: Reworked into [Int check (6):Move target forward]
-Rap Knuckles: Fracture(4)->Fracture(8)
-Blood flow: Apply Bleeding(4)->Apply Bleeding(8)
-Body Collision: Reworked into [Str check (6):Move target backward]
-Tough: Add Exhaust
-Lower gesture: Add [this character Move backward]
-Dogfight: Speed changed from Rapid -> Instant, Gain taunt(3) ->Taunt(1), Apply Decay(3）-> Apply Decay(1)
-Hell Smite: Damage 16->10, Apply Vulnerable(4) Weaken(4) -> Apply vulnerable(8) Weaken(8)
-Provoke Strike: Add [Move target forward]
-Hard Confront: Add [Move target forward]
-Sheild Strike: Add [this character Move forward]
-Reckless Strike: Add [this character Move forward]
-Speeding Attack: Speed changed from Slow to Rapid, Damage 16 ->4
-Instant Reaction: Reworked into [target Draw (1) ; Combo: Recycle (1) card]
-Haste: Speed changed form Rapid to Instant, Gain Hyperspeed(1) -> Gain Sprint(1)
-Knife Assault: Damage 5 ->6, [Combo: deal 5 damage] ->[Combo: deal basic damage]
-Fishing Shot:  Add [Move target forward]
-Reverse wind: Add [Move target backward], [Apply Stunning(1)]-> [Apply Slowing(1)]
-Hunter's Hook: Add [Move target backward]
-Read glyph: Speed changed from Rapid -> Instant, remove [Read (3); this character Draw (1)]
-Rapid Flow: Add [Move target backward] to Mastery ability
-Mana Fragment: Speed changed from Rapid to Instant, Damage 8->4, Reworked into [Focus: Recycle (1) Skill card]
-Progress Study: Speed changed from Rapid -> Instant
-Waving Shield: [Aftermath: Apply armor(5) to all allies] ->[Aftermath: Apply armor(5) to a random ally]
-Dismiss: Add Exhaust
-Tainted remedy: Rework into [Apply recovery(3); Whenever this character applies Poisonous: Retrieve this card]
-Fright: Add [Move target backward]
-Maiming Trap: Vulnerable(3)->(6), Weaken(3)->(6), Bleeding(3) ->(6) Poisonous(3)->(6)
-Death Bolt: Apply Aging(2) -> Apply Aging(1) 
-Void Tentacle: Add [Move target forward]
-Thunder Seek: Speed changed from Rapid -> Instant
-Blooding Restore: [Hurt(10) : Gain Recovery(5)] -> [Hurt(10) : Gain Resurge(1)]
-Brave Move: No longer provide Taunt

-Thunder Chain: Speed changed form Slow->Rapid
-AEther Tonic: Reworked into [Gain Enhance(2); Rebound: Gain Decay(3)]


[h2]Tools[/h2]
Some tools can now be used during battles: Grindstone, Wardrum, Paper Shields, Paper Hat, Regeneration Potion, Hexproof Potion, Lifeguard Potion, Compound AE
